Thus the purity of the knower and the purity of body-consciousness are not two, cannot be made two, are not separate, are not different. Whatever is the purity of the seer, that is the purity of body-consciousness; whatever is the purity of body-consciousness, that is the purity of the seer. Thus the purity of the seer and the purity of body-consciousness are not two, cannot be made two, are not separate, are not different.
